name: jsoncons
input_api: jsoncons::json::parse(const char*, size_t) on local bytes
family_note: The JSON parser is header-only and does not delegate to the other selected C++ JSON parser families. JSON construction and serialization are separate from the parser-only AFL++ probe.
scope: UTF-8 JSON in local length-bounded bytes up to 1 MiB, parsed into a JSON value tree. No malformed-input or numeric-boundary claim.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon installations of the dedicated -dev package (by_inst)
popularity.caveat: Three Debian installations are too few for a strong popularity claim; the package also contains non-JSON format support. The saved lead records 859 GitHub stars, which are a different metric and are not mixed into the Debian ranking.

selection_caveat: The low but comparable Debian metric does not automatically justify selected top-ten status.
